title: My hobbies
summary: Someone talks about running, football and listening to music.

sentences.zh: 我有很多爱好，我最喜欢的是运动。
sentences.en: I have lots of hobbies; my favourite is sport.

sentences.zh: 每天早上，我都去外面跑步。
sentences.en: Every morning I go running outside.

sentences.zh: 我一边跑步一边听歌，一点儿也不累。
sentences.en: I listen to music while I run, so I don't get tired at all.
Each time I run for forty minutes.

sentences.zh: 每个星期六，我跟朋友们一起去学校踢球。
sentences.en: Every Saturday I go to the school with my friends to play football.

sentences.zh: 我踢得不太好，但是很快乐。
sentences.en: I don't play very well, but it makes me happy.

sentences.zh: 我的朋友小王踢得最好，他从小就开始踢足球了。
sentences.en: My friend Xiao Wang plays best; he started playing as a child.

sentences.zh: 晚上回家了，我喜欢看书。
sentences.en: In the evening, back home, I like reading.

sentences.zh: 我觉得，有爱好的人，身体好，每天也很高兴。
sentences.en: I think people with hobbies are healthy and happy every day.

questions.prompt: What is the writer's favourite hobby?
why: Right: 我最喜欢的是运动.
Reading is a hobby too, but not the favourite.

questions.prompt: What do they do while running?
why: Right: 我一边跑步一边听歌.
They run alone in the park in the morning.
You can't watch TV while running in the park.
The writer says 我踢得不太好.

questions.prompt: How long does each run last?
why: Right: 我每次跑四十分钟.
